findings.source_passage: All this struck me as mighty singular; yet, upon second thoughts, there was something almost sublime in it.
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'But savages are strange beings'
findings.why_it_matters: This pivot sentence is Ishmael's interpretive hinge between noticing Queequeg's aloofness and the rapturous Cape Horn reflection; without it the philosophical flight feels unmotivated and the narrator's characteristic move from perception to wonder is erased.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'All this struck me as mighty singular; yet, upon second thoughts, there was something almost sublime in it.' immediately before the Cape Horn passage to preserve the rhetorical escalation.

findings.source_passage: he seemed entirely at his ease; preserving the utmost serenity; content with his own companionship; always equal to himself. Surely this was a touch of fine philosophy; though no doubt he had never heard there was such a thing as that.
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'But savages are strange beings'
findings.why_it_matters: The source's exact phrase 'Surely this was a touch of fine philosophy; though no doubt he had never heard there was such a thing as that' is the ironic payoff of the paragraph; the draft replaces it with 'Surely there was fine philosophy there, unknowing itself,' erasing the deadpan Melvillean wit of 'he had never heard there was such a thing.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore verbatim: 'Surely this was a touch of fine philosophy; though no doubt he had never heard there was such a thing as that.'

findings.source_passage: especially considering the affectionate arm I had found thrown over me upon waking in the morning, I thought this indifference of his very strange
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'Whilst I was thus closely scanning him'
findings.why_it_matters: The callback to the previous night's accidental embrace is a small but characterful beat of Ishmael's embarrassed sociability; its omission removes a thread of continuity with Chapter 12.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a brief clause noting the indifference seemed strange given the affectionate arm of the previous morning, even if compressed.

summary: All canonical signature passages are preserved, but two medium-severity losses—the 'almost sublime' pivot and the exact ironic phrasing of the 'fine philosophy' sentence—flatten Ishmael's characteristic movement from observation to wit; the draft passes but should restore those two phrases in any revision pass.
